reviews.text:
My child learned the word "nursery school" almost immediately after starting at this nursery school 🌷 It seems they are so excited about nursery school ✨ The pictures you send me every time are so cute that I save them all and my album fills up quickly lol
Thank you for everything, and I look forward to continuing to use your services 😊
We have been using their services since our dog was 6 months old. Not only do they provide thorough training, but they also give us precise advice on what to do at home.

Thank you so much for everything you do for us! 💕💕

It's been three months since we started the STUDY course! 🐶🐶💓
The nursery's exterior is so cute, and the kind, cheerful, and lovely teachers welcome us, making going there a joyful experience! 🙌🏻✨️
Both of our dogs are so excited on the mornings they go to nursery! 🥰✨️
We really feel the love for our dogs in everything from the little decorations inside, the detailed communication logs, the fun events, and even the casual conversations. 🥺💗
Thank you so much for all the preparations you made for the events! 🫶🏻✨️
The overall atmosphere of the nursery is wonderful; we call it our power spot! 💕💕
We know the teachers are very busy every day, so please take care of yourselves! 🥰
We look forward to continuing our relationship with you! 🙏🏻✨

We regularly bring our dog in for a grooming course. His fur tends to get matted easily, but they always give him a neat and tidy trim. Our dog seems happy too; he gets excited and happy on the days he goes to his favorite groomer.

I bring my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel in for grooming every 1-2 months. They always style him exactly as I request, and I'm very satisfied!

My dog ​​loves the staff, so he gets very excited on grooming days! ✨

The shop is bright and clean, so I always enjoy using their services!

My child started attending when he was seven months old, and lately he looks forward to going to daycare. As soon as he sees the entrance, he runs off full of energy. All the staff are always smiling and very friendly. I also appreciate that they send videos and photos of his training and how he plays with other children, so I can keep track of how he's doing.

We're grateful for your grooming services.

My dog ​​looks forward to each visit.

You always greet us with a lovely smile, and your pre-grooming consultations are thorough. You also offer suggestions, which helps prevent things from becoming monotonous.

We look forward to continuing to use your services.

We send both of our dogs to the daycare once a week.

Our princely-type dog used to bite our hands when he didn't like grooming or other things, and would sometimes be harsh with our older dog when stressed, which was a problem. However, through interaction with the trainers and other dogs, and through training, he's gradually changing.

He seems to really enjoy the training and is begging the trainers to do more! ☺︎
He could only sit at first, but he's getting better every day.

The photos and videos you send us each time are a real treat for our family!

Both of our dogs absolutely love the daycare, and as soon as we arrive at the entrance, they wag their tails and run straight in! ♡

We feel at ease leaving them in their familiar environment for grooming, and their haircuts are always adorable! ✨

We've been sending our dog to the daycare since it opened!

The teachers really pay attention to each dog's individual personality.

They also kept us updated regularly when we used their hotel service, so we had no worries at all!

Our dog loves going there so much that he gets excited as soon as we get to Gotanda Station.

My dog ​​has been attending daycare once a week since she was 7 months old.

My dog ​​loves daycare because she can play with the teachers and other dogs!

We receive updates on her daycare activities via LINE.

We can see her playing with her friends and looking happy when she's praised during one-on-one training with her favorite teacher.

We also used their hotel service.

During hotel stays, she can play with the other dogs who come to daycare during the day.

We receive detailed reports with videos and photos in the morning, afternoon, and evening, so we never had to worry about anything and always knew she was having fun.

Thank you for everything!

My toy poodle girl, who will soon be two years old, has been attending DOG RHYTHM TAKANAWA once a week for over a year. It's a very welcoming and friendly school, and the instructors are always smiling and kind. They give her their all and teach her various tricks and obedience training until she has mastered them. My dog ​​loves daycare, so the photos they send me from daycare always show her smiling!

My older child was shy around people and dogs, and at first, she would stay in the corner of the classroom. But now, she loves the teacher and invites her friends to play.

My younger child seems to be having a great time playing with lots of friends♬
She also loves training, and the teachers let her try new things. I look forward to the photos and videos we receive each time 🥰
I'm so glad we enrolled her here 💕

We've been coming here since the pre-opening.

On sunny days, our dog gets plenty of exercise both indoors and outdoors, and sleeps soundly when we get home. Thank you for the adorable photos and videos!

The grooming is always perfect!
I'm always so happy with how beautifully and cutely you finish things! 🐶✨ …

Our dog has been attending Dog Rhythm since he was 7 months old.

After a trial day, we were so impressed by the atmosphere between the dogs and the staff that we decided to enroll him, feeling confident that we could leave him there with peace of mind.

When he first started, he couldn't even walk on a leash or sit properly, but the trainer patiently taught him, and now he's very good at it.

In the mornings he goes to daycare, he happily gets into his bag on his own, and when he comes back, he sleeps soundly with a satisfied look on his face.

They always write detailed reports in the communication notebook, and they also give us a detailed verbal update on his day when we drop him off and pick him up.

Furthermore, they send us lots of photos and videos of him having fun with his dog friends, which we rarely get to see at home, and our family looks forward to seeing them.

There's also a groomer always on-site, so both our dog and we feel at ease knowing he can get groomed in a familiar environment.

This is a highly recommended place for dogs who want to play with lots of friends! 🐶💕

We use their daycare and grooming services.

Our dog loves the kind teachers and groomers and enjoys going every time 🐾
They send us cute photos and videos from both the daycare and grooming sessions, so we, as owners, look forward to seeing what kind of pictures we'll get each time ♪
Thank you for your continued support 🫧
